script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. SMALL-TOWN GYM - DAY

The sun filters in through dusty windows, illuminating a worn wooden floor and old weights. COACH CARR (50s) stands at the far end, eyes scanning the room for new talent. Enter PROTAGONIST, JAMES (20s), a local boy, fresh-faced and determined.

JAMES
(confident)
Coach Carr, I think I can make the team.

COACH CARR
(skeptical)
You've got spirit, kid, but it takes more than that to make our football team.

INT. JAMES'S KITCHEN - NIGHT

James sits at the table with his parents, explaining his newfound passion for football. They worry about the cost of equipment and training, but James is determined.

JAMES
(excited)
I've found a way, Mom, Dad. There's a scholarship program for local kids at the state university. I just need to make the team and I can go.

INT. SMALL-TOWN FIELD - DAY

James and other hopefuls practice under Coach Carr's watchful eye. They run drills, lift weights, and perfect their form.

COACH CARR
(to James)
You've got potential, James. But you're behind the others. Keep practicing.

INT. JAMES'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

James lies awake, determined to catch up to his teammates. He devises a plan: he'll wake up early every morning to practice alone and study game footage.

INT. SMALL-TOWN LIBRARY - DAY

James watches video after video of professional football games, taking notes. He borrows books on strategy, nutrition, and conditioning.

INT. SMALL-TOWN FIELD - MORNING

James practices alone, his dedication evident in every rep. Sweat drips from his brow as he pushes himself to the limit.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

James meets with his teammates, sharing his newfound knowledge. They're impressed and inspired by his dedication.

TEAMMATE 1
(in awe)
You've been up every morning, practicing? That's insane!

JAMES
(smiling)
It's what it takes to make the team.

INT. SMALL-TOWN GYM - DAY

Coach Carr watches as James and his teammates spar in a mock game. He's impressed by James's improved form and strategy.

COACH CARR
(proud)
You're getting there, James. Keep pushing yourself.

INT. SMALL-TOWN FIELD - GAME DAY

The team faces off against a rival town. James plays a key role, demonstrating his new skills and leading the team to victory.

INT. SMALL-TOWN CELEBRATION - NIGHT

The team celebrates their win, with James at the heart of the celebration. He's earned the respect of his teammates and the adoration of his town.

FADE OUT.

This screenplay, "From the Ground Up," is a modern, gun-free sports story about a small-town boy's determination to make his high school football team. It showcases the theme of perseverance and the power of dedication to achieve one's goals.
